en:
The dots tell of a people. In this cave we lived,
and the cave gave us everything we had.

The dots go on. All we owned we owed to the
Pokémon, who shared the land with us.

The dots grow stern. But we sealed the Pokémon
away, and shut them in the dark.

The dots are crowded here. We feared their
power, and we feared what it might do.

The dots are steadier again. Those who come
with courage and with hope, let them go on.

The last dots: open the door, and an eternal
Pokémon waits behind it.
